integrity: Statements are supported by an exhaustive finite graph-equivalence proof and two complete executable Python 3 enumeration implementations; no independent external scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for q=n=4, minimum Hamming distance two and strict non-overlap. Single substitutions can be detected between distinct words, not corrected; no reverse-complement, balance, edit-distance, or biological assay claim. Some possibly relevant unindexed computations and an inaccessible recent publisher full text leave bibliographic risk.
title: Exact quaternary four-symbol mutually uncorrelated codes with single-substitution detection
